verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Copilot privacy FAQ says users can opt out of having their conversation activity used for model training at any time. It also says conversations are otherwise used to train its generative AI models, so the opt-out is meaningful. A community comment only voices uncertainty about training and does not concretely contradict the documented control. Missing for 10: details on where and how the opt-out is set, clarity on scope beyond conversation activity (e.g., voice, uploaded files, Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
